title: Victron BMV Overnight Battery Draw
dataSources: Battery telemetry (`marine:battery`), AIS traffic (`marine:ais`), shore power (`marina:power`), tide forecasts (`tide:table`), export syncs (`marine:export`).
app: Boating and marine telemetry — Victron BMV battery exports, AIS transponder logs, shore-power meter readings, and NOAA tide tables — streamed to Splunk HEC via NMEA exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=marine:battery battery_bank=* overnight_draw_ah=*
| stats avg(overnight_draw_ah) as avg_overnight_draw_ah, count as events by battery_bank
| sort - avg_overnight_draw_ah
description: Shows average overnight amp-hour draw by battery bank for overnight marine power use.
value: Average overnight amp-hour draw by battery bank helps compare overnight marine power use across the factors that matter most.
implementation: Capture `overnight_draw_ah` on `marine:battery` events and normalize `battery_bank` so Splunk can summarize performance by battery bank.
visualization: Bar chart of average overnight amp-hour draw by battery bank.
grandmaExplanation: It records the average overnight amp-hour draw for each battery bank so you can see what works best for overnight marine power use.
